scene.title: Lifted Home, Waiting Wind (Turn 4)
scene.text:
The air presses around us with the hiss of wind and rope-dark shadows. I glare at the churning ceiling, Toto tucked tight in my lap, and I press my heel into the floor as the house rides the cyclone’s breath. I whisper to Toto: stay calm, stay close. My heartbeat keeps time with the creak of timbers and the howl that rattles the lantern’s glass. The ladder groans, the trapdoor yawns below, and the world tilts again. I keep my body braced, my eyes fixed on the lantern’s stubborn glow, ready to move only if the floor tells me to. We don’t know what comes next, but we’ll endure together, Toto against the wind and fear.

Aunt Em’s call echoes somewhere distant in memory, but for now the house is our small harbor in a blue-black sky, and I wait for the cyclone to end, waiting with Toto pressed to my chest until a stubborn lull gives us a moment to breathe.
scene.outcomeReason: The cyclone continues its ascent; Dorothy and Toto endure the ride, awaiting a moment of quiet or a turn in the weather that could reveal their next move.
